text:
Alex Chen: Weekend poll — tacos downtown or backyard stargazing? I bought a small reflector and also really crave street tacos. 🌮🔭
Maria Gomez: Both sound great. I can bring a thermos and a blanket for the stars.
Noah Patel: Tacos for me. Which taco places are we hitting? I have hot takes on salsa.
Sophia Lin: If we stargaze I can bring my star-map app + mini tripod. Moon phase should be good for deep-sky peek (low moon).
Kyle R.: Vote: tacos 👍 / stargaze 👀
Alex Chen: Tally so far — tacos: 1 (Noah), stargaze: 2 (Maria, Sophia). Hmm.
Jamal (silent observer): what time are we thinking for either?
Alex Chen: Tacos early (6pm) or stargaze later (after 9pm).
Maria Gomez: I can do either. Also down to do stargaze then late ramen after — very mood.
Noah Patel: 6pm tacos works. Suggested route: La Taqueria -> El Gallo -> Tacos al Aire. Start at 6:15?
Sophia Lin: If tacos start 6:15 I can do tacos then join stargaze after if ppl are still awake.
Kyle R.: Hybrid = tacos then optional stargaze? dangerous but yes.
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop reservations required for stargaze — please book here: https://redwood-rooftop/reserve :robot_face:
Alex Chen: Good call ops-bot. If rooftop, need a headcount. Reply 'yes' if you might join both.
Maria Gomez: yes
Noah Patel: tacos only for me, but thanks!
Sophia Lin: yes to both
Kyle R.: yes (probably both)
Alex Chen: OK — plan: tacos first, optional rooftop stargaze after. I'll DM for headcount and set meeting spot. Meet at Union Square fountain ~6:10pm. See you! :thumbsup:
